headline: Seven wins and six defeats outside the conference, and sixteen days until the table means anything.
dek: Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State are the only sides still unbeaten. Outside its own membership the conference has scored twenty goals and conceded twelve, and the table stays empty until September 17.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Five different players have scored for Ouachita Baptist, more than for any other side in the conference.

chart.caption: Goals scored per side, all non-conference, through Aug 30.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tristan Miller has saved ten of the eleven shots on target he has faced for Rogers State.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Wesley Rodriguez has two goals from four shots — a finish every second attempt.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist have scored six goals, more than Southern Nazarene, Northeastern State and Harding have managed together.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thirteen matches carry a published score, out of 93 on the season's card.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: One match is marked final with no published score. Four more are past their date with no result recorded at all.

last_match.line: The only match on the day's card, and Northeastern State could not score in it.

next_match.line: Ouachita Baptist have yet to concede; Delta State have already won at Harding.

table_state.statement: Conference play begins Sep 17. No side has played a conference match, and the table stays empty until one does.
table_state.footnote: Early form is shown from non-conference results · a pre-conference table is a valid state.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
